newsitem.title: USA: Indianapolis bus is not the best getaway car.
newsitem.headline: Indianapolis bus is not the best getaway car.

text.p: Two teenaged robbers held up a supermarket Friday and then made a dash for their getaway car -- a city bus.
The bus driver, unaware of the robbery, made one of the boys don his shirt before allowing him to board.
Police stopped the bus a few blocks away, arrested the pair, both under 16, and recovered an undisclosed amount of cash.
"These guys have to be among America's dumbest criminals," passenger Tom Testa said.
